scientific_integrity: The already published minimum weight six is explicitly credited. All new enumerative and orbit claims are supported by structural proofs and by two exact standalone finite enumerations; neither constitutes external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The census and orbit statement are exact only for the ten-vertex Petersen graph. It does not establish a result for larger generalized Petersen graphs. The full 2021 proceedings section was not retrieved and historical priority may require additional source checks.
title: Complete two-rainbow independent domination census of the Petersen graph
